ranks.name: Passenger
ranks.blurb: Welcome aboard. Every visitor starts here.
perks: Your Sol Passport and its first stamps
The Passenger badge on your nameplate

ranks.name: Pilot
ranks.blurb: You have found your way around Solport.
perks: Pilot wings on your nameplate, seen by everyone
Stamp Travel: travel instantly from your passport to any place you have stamped
Runway Silver paint for your golf cart

ranks.name: Captain
ranks.blurb: A regular of Genesis, known all over the site.
perks: The Captain's gold badge and nameplate trim
Captain's Cheer: your Cheer emote launches a gold firework everyone nearby can see
Captain Navy paint for your golf cart

ranks.name: Tower
ranks.blurb: The rarest rank. You have seen everything Genesis has to offer.
perks: The Tower beacon badge on your nameplate
The Tower Lookout: ride the lift to the roof deck of the Solport control tower
Tower Crimson paint for your golf cart

impact.label: In-game impact
impact.note: Counts what everyone does in Genesis: passport stamps, first conversations, flights, landings, activities, rides and daily visits. It is a game counter only: no money is involved and nothing here is a donation.

howto.d: Arrive at a place in the passport to stamp it.
Your first conversation with Brad, Paul, Jake, Joe and Will.
Talk to Sky and every named character on the site.
Every stamp on a page earns a bonus and a reward: a title, a cart paint or a seal.
Desert Golf, the Cart Course, the Drag Strip, the Low-G Course, Sky Rings, Founders' Cache, Fingers Lap, the Bull Ride, a Dance Battle, the Balloon Race and an arcade prize.
Complete a flight in Giveback One.
howto.xp: +150 XP the first flight, then +40 and a score bonus

howto.d: Bring a jet down safely on the runway.
The Outpost Rover, the Stagecoach, The Crossing shuttle, a site shuttle or a friend's cart.
howto.xp: +60 XP the first of each, then +10

howto.d: The welcome checklist you get after the tutorial.
Your first visit each day, plus a streak bonus that grows each day in a row. Extra bonuses at 3, 7, 14 and 30 days.
When the community impact meter reaches a milestone and you have taken part.

howto.xp: +1,000 XP and the Sol Voyager title

rules: Ranks are earned by play only. They are never bought and never tied to coins, tokens or money. Repeat XP from activities, flights, landings and rides is capped each day; stamps, firsts and bonuses are not.
